headline: Apple ordered to pay $5.7 billion in haptic patent verdict
summary: A federal jury in San Diego awarded Taction Technology over $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed two patents on vibration-based haptic feedback technology, stemming from a 2021 lawsuit. Apple is reportedly looking to appeal the verdict.

claims.statement: A federal jury in San Diego awarded Taction over $5.7 billion in damages after finding Apple infringed its haptic patents.
